authLayout.tagline: Production-ready auth, profile, 2FA, and media flows wired to your .NET backend.

landing.title: (Code base)
landing.heroSubtitle: A modern starter for end-user apps — JWT auth, i18n, typed APIs, and real backend integration.
landing.featuresTitle: What you get out of the box
landing.featureAuth: Auth (login/register/refresh, Google sign-in, forgot/reset password, verify email)
landing.featureMedia: Media lab: presigned upload → complete → poll status

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: JWT + refresh token. Supports two-factor authentication.
login.twoFaHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
login.apiUnreachable: Cannot reach API. Start backend: cd src/Backend/Api && dotnet run --launch-profile https

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Uses idempotency key automatically.
register.success: Registered. Check your email if verification is required.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We will send a reset link if the email exists.
forgotPassword.sent: If that email is registered, a reset link has been sent.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
resetPassword.success: Password updated. You can sign in now.

verifyEmail.title: Verify email
verifyEmail.success: Email verified. You can sign in now.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your account and quick links.
dashboard.tip: Use the nav to test Profile, 2FA, and Media Lab.

profile.title: Profile
profile.avatarHint: Profile API has no avatar field yet. Upload demonstrates the media flow for future avatar support.

twoFa.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFa.setupHint: Begin setup → scan QR in authenticator app → enter 6-digit code.

media.title: Media Lab
media.flowHint: Initiate → PUT to presigned URL → Complete → Poll GET until Ready.

google.notConfigured: Google sign-in is not configured (set NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

support.title: Support center
support.description: Open and track support tickets with live updates from the admin team.
support.subject: Subject
support.selectTicket: Select a ticket to view details.

pricing.title: Plans & pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose a subscription plan for your organization (tenant).

about.title: About us
about.body: We build a multi-tenant SaaS platform with subscription plans for organizations and a personal credit wallet for metered features on the main app.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about billing, tenants, or your account? Reach out anytime.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to a plan
subscribe.subtitle: Creates a new tenant and subscription (MVP checkout — no payment provider yet).

tenantUsage.title: Organization usage
tenantUsage.subtitle: Subscription status and plan limits for your active tenant.
tenantUsage.cancelConfirm: Cancel this organization's subscription? Write access will be removed.
tenantUsage.ssoHint: Members can sign in with your identity provider using an OIDC id_token.
tenantUsage.ssoClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep existing secret
tenantUsage.ssoNotConfigured: SSO is not configured yet. Save to create settings.

tenantPublic.appEntryHint: We set your active tenant context. Continue to the main app for profile, support, and media.

wallet.title: Personal wallet
wallet.subtitle: Credits are per user — not tied to your tenant subscription.
